shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat (balcony-rule targeting, mortars on map coords, real-time rendering, sound and shake, Combat Extended bridge with high-ground suppression/accuracy), and NPC arrivals/departures over ridge routes and tunnel mouths behind per-category toggles. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553; window 4 in build mode.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, `(w, 1, bandCount*Slot)`; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)*64`; 64-alignment load-bearing.
**The one insight:** `Region.Neighbors` is topological; Portal wormholes conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temp/vacuum; the jobified pathfinder cannot cross a synthetic link → segmented movement.
**⚠⚠ `CanReach` = "with stairs"; pathfinder = "walking now"** (§34, §40).
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK GENERALISES TO NEITHER UTILITIES NOR COMBAT; where it meets combat, connectivity wins and looks like a combat bug (§41i); it is why exits leaked before §43.**
**⚠ THE GUTTER:** shells scatter into it (§41f), radial searches reach it (§41i), skyfaller offsets cross it (§41b), spanning shoot lines walk through it (§41k), **and a CE round would COLLIDE through it - CE projectiles have real flight collision, which is why the CE origin remap is mandatory, not cosmetic (§44)**.
**⚠ THE VIEW IS DOWNWARD-ONLY; physics, combat rendering, sound and traffic are symmetric.**
**⚠⚠ ANISOTROPY BREAKS EVERY RAW DISTANCE TEST.** `BandOf` CLAMPS. Window 4 count: TEN+ instances.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, ten shapes — table unchanged (anchor/field/noise/extent/aspect/scalar/foreign-writes/radius-vs-gutter/list-sweep/raw-participant-maths). `ABBandLocal.cs` is the canonical FIELD rewrite. Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — 126/128 (7 cap) · **190/192 (4)** · 254/256 (2); one efficient height per 64-step; 200 is the number to avoid; plan persists between colonies.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA — segmented at `StartPath`; hops strictly decrease; multi-hop ✅. TWO CARRY TRIGGERS, must agree on the ending (§33c/h). **ONE DESCENT RULE + ONE SANCTIONED SIBLING (`ABShaft.ColumnOpen`)** shared by ballistics/relays/flecks/audio. 4d closed the last single-band corner (realtime things).

# 8b. DEPTH SHRINK — loose contents only; terrain never; no shrink for flecks/relayed things.

# 9. GENERATION COST — FillRock tracks HILLINESS (superlinear in band size); RAINFALL dominates Plants. **⚠⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES TEST VALIDITY - INCLUDING COMBAT (test OUTDOORS).** 9g queue: basement rock suppression first.

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove innocence by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. One change per experiment. Diagnostic before theory; after five failed theories, SHIP THE INSTRUMENT.
**⚠⚠ COUNT EMITTERS/HOMES/POPULATIONS/DERIVATIONS/SENSES/DIRECTIONS - AND ENGINE STACKS** (§44: CE is a parallel combat engine; a patch on the vanilla type is INERT, not wrong - the giveaway is "works without CE, dead with it").
**⚠⚠ A REMAP CAN NEUTRALIZE YOUR OWN DOWNSTREAM HOOK** (§44 suppression: by AddSuppression time the origin is OUR remapped cell, band delta zero - the scale must read the projectile's LAUNCHER, which still stands on the true band. When you rewrite coordinates at a producer, every consumer that compares coordinates needs an untouched source of truth).
**⚠⚠ SURFACE-ONLY-BY-ACCIDENT IS NOT A RULE** (§43). **⚠⚠ SECOND ENTRY POINTS, NOT FACTION CHECKS** (§41i). **⚠⚠ HELPERS REIMPLEMENTING RANGE/BEARING/ANCHOR MATHS ARE INVISIBLE TO VERB PATCHES** (n=8: + CE's CanHitTargetFrom raw report maths). **⚠⚠ "DECLINE TO HELP" IS NOT "DENY"** (§41c - and CE's fallthrough also decides on raw range, so the CE bridge denies too). **⚠⚠ MOVEMENT SYMPTOMS CAN BE RANGE CHECKS; THINK TREES DISGUISE FAILED NODES.** **⚠⚠ THE MISS PATHS ARE A SECOND FEATURE.** **⚠⚠ ONE-PAWN-TYPE REPORTS AREN'T TYPE-SPECIFIC. ⚠⚠ DERIVED ANSWERS CAN'T BEAT SOURCES. ⚠⚠ BLIND INSTRUMENTS. ⚠⚠ TELEPORT EXITS RE-DISPATCH. ⚠⚠ thingIDNumber STATICS. ⚠⚠ ONE GESTURE, THREE PATHS. ⚠⚠ REVERT-FIRST. ⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT'S ALREADY BUILT/DOCUMENTED.**
**⚠ THE USER'S EYE BEATS THE AGENT'S ARITHMETIC** (§41l). **⚠ FLAVOR NEVER BREAKS AN INCIDENT: FALLBACKS ARE LOAD-BEARING** (§43). **⚠ PARTICIPATION BY ALLOWLIST** (§43 latches; §44 Prepare-gates). **⚠ A SHADOW CAN BE DRAWN WHERE NOBODY LOOKS. ⚠ HONESTY RULES CAN BE REPLACED BY MORE HONEST RULES. ⚠ EXACT-MATCH KEYS ON SCATTERED VALUES MISS ON EVERY MISS; TOLERANCES COVER THE WORST LEGAL SCATTER. ⚠ FOUR CASES, ONE DEFECT. ⚠ IMPOSSIBLE FEATURES MAY BE FREE. ⚠ GUARDS ARE PER-CONSUMER. ⚠ COUNT CONSUMERS. ⚠ FUNNEL BRANCHES LIE UNEQUALLY. ⚠ COPY GOES STALE; NEVER UPDATE AHEAD OF VERIFICATION. ⚠ RECORD FALSE POSITIVES. ⚠ DOCUMENTED ROUNDING ERRORS CAN BEAT FRAGILE FIXES.** *(Full one-liner archive: thresholds/markers/reverts/guards/agreement/not-same/arithmetic-signatures/helpers'-call-sites/three-copies/four-defects/loop-direction/stateless-inputs/radius-reasons/no-sync-pathfinds-in-draw/user-premise/burst-methods/one-claim/delete-unmattering-work/overlay-renderer-agreement/five-returns/agent-log/config-expressiveness/quantised-params/heaviest-budgets/wrong-axis-models/lying-UIs/n=2/half-ordering/read-suspect-data/mod-x-regressions/whole-subsystems/predicate-conditions/two-resolvers/n-mods/foreign-defs/dependency-lists/enums/decompile-versions/compat-is-deletion/false-comments/burst-fps/0.0ms/downstream-errors/dispatch-x-calls/appended-catch.)*
**Patching.** Wrap DATA; patch PRODUCERS; INNER METHODS over wrappers; **no foreign types in patch signatures - §44 is the fullest exercise: every CE patch binds by vanilla/Unity types + index params (`__0`,`ref __1`), TargetMethod() by name, Prepare() validates the full parameter SHAPE so a CE rename degrades one seam silently and the combat report names it**; prefix releases in FINALIZERS; `[ThreadStatic]` latches; RE-ENTER WITH CORRECTED INPUTS; REIMPLEMENT WHEN GUARDS SIT AHEAD; POSTFIX-CORRECT COSMETICS; BOX/SETVALUE/UNBOX structs (CE's report is a CLASS - postfix repairs directly); REBUILD IMMUTABLE-ANCHOR STRUCTS; gate LIFETIME or OBSERVER.
**Engine facts.** *(archive unchanged: snow/TerrainHard/dontRender/Banded-gen/worker-thread FinalizeInit/finalizers/FogGrid/LudeonTK/BandOf-clamps/discarded-games/TickList-no-throttle/StartingTicksToImpact-3D.)*
**⚠⚠ CE FACTS (§44).** CE verbs derive from `Verb_LaunchProjectileCE` (Verb subclass - `ABCombatV2.TrySolve/OwnsPair` work on it unchanged ✓). **Shot line = `TryFindCEShootLineFromTo(root, targ, out line, out targetPos)` (virtual, 4-arg is the body)** - CanHitTargetFrom and TryCastShot both call it. **Accuracy = `ShiftVecReportFor(target, targetCell)` → ShiftVecReport (a CLASS: cover/smokeDensity/swayDegrees/spreadDegrees public fields)**; `shotDist` from raw cells; cover/smoke from a raw line walk. **Aim vector = `ShiftTarget(report, Vector3 v, out targetHeight, bool, bool)`** - bearing, ballistic angle and lead all derive from `v - sourceLoc` (Vector2 = caster TrueCenter 2D). **`ProjectileCE : ThingWithComps`, NOT Verse.Projectile; `Launch(launcher, Vector2 origin, shotAngle, shotRotation, shotHeight, shotSpeed, equipment, distance)` - the Vector2's y IS the map z; rounds fly simulated arcs with REAL COLLISION along the 2D path.** **Suppression funnel = `CompSuppressable.AddSuppression(amount, origin)`; applied from `ProjectileCE.ApplySuppression(Pawn, float mult)`; `SuppressionUtility` is the REACTION side (cover-seeking), not the applier.** Turrets = `Building_TurretGunCE`; acquisition still routes through vanilla `AttackTargetFinder` (§41i postfix covers CE turrets too).
**⚠⚠ block archive:** PATHING/REGION (§34) · PATHER LIFECYCLE (§33h) · DRAW (§39/§41b) · SELECTION (§35) · ORDERING (§33f) · COMBAT (§41) · AUDIO (§42) · TRAVEL (§43: entry funnel anatomy; exit raw-coordinate projection; EdgeWalkIn covers non-overriding subclasses; Distributed re-enters per group; NeutralGroup funnel) - unchanged from their sections.

# 44. COMBAT EXTENDED — 4f, BUILT UNRUN

**The user's spec:** CE support + the high-ground model: *upper pawns get suppression resistance and increased accuracy against pawns below; lower pawns are more easily suppressed by pawns above.*

**44a. WHY §41 WAS INERT UNDER CE.** CE replaces the entire layer - own shot-line (`TryFindCEShootLineFromTo`), own accuracy (`ShiftVecReport`), own projectile (`ProjectileCE`, not a `Verse.Projectile`, flying a simulated arc with REAL collision). Every §41 patch keys on vanilla types → under CE, cross-band pairs failed raw range and nobody fired. **A patch on the wrong engine stack is INERT, not wrong.**

**44b. THE BRIDGE - §41's three steps at CE's seams, ALL REFLECTION-ONLY** (no CE type in any signature; TargetMethod by name; Prepare validates parameter shape; a CE rename degrades one seam and the combat report names it):
1. **Legality:** prefix on the 4-arg `TryFindCEShootLineFromTo` - permit via `ABCombatV2.TrySolve` (works unchanged: CE verbs ARE Verbs), DENY owned pairs (CE's fallthrough is raw-range, §41c again). Records the parked solution. Covers player targeting, AI, and turrets (CE acquisition still runs through vanilla `AttackTargetFinder` → §41i's postfix already serves it).
2. **Aim space:** `ShiftVecReportFor(target, targetCell)` prefix localizes the cell (shotDist band-local) + postfix strips fabricated cover/smoke (§41k verbatim - CE aims around sampled covers, they are not decoration) **+ applies the high-ground accuracy bonus: shooter above target → swayDegrees and spreadDegrees x0.8.** `ShiftTarget`'s `Vector3 v` prefix-localized into the caster's band - bearing, ballistic angle and lead all derive from it; self-contained band-compare trigger, no latch.
3. **Origin:** `ProjectileCE.Launch` prefix - `TryPeekSolutionFor(rootBand)` (same tick + root band; CE launches carry no target cell to near-match, but record→launch is one TryCastShot stack, pellets included) → **the Vector2 origin's y (= map z) moves into the target's band** → the round flies band-locally where the target lives: collisions, suppression and impact on the correct level. Registered with the relay (retyped `Projectile`→`Thing` for exactly this) → ceiling-holes rendering for free; the below realtime pass excludes relay-handled things without an isinst gate now (CE rounds are not Verse.Projectile - the type test would have re-opened the double-draw for CE specifically).

**44c. HIGH-GROUND SUPPRESSION - one signed rule.** `SuppressionScale(shooterBand, victimBand)`: shooter ABOVE victim → x1.5; BELOW → x0.5; level → untouched. Both halves of the user's spec fall out of the one comparison.
**⚠⚠ THE HOOK CANNOT BE AddSuppression's ORIGIN, AND THE REASON IS OUR OWN REMAP:** by that point the origin cell is the remapped one - same band as the victim, delta zero, permanently. **A remap at the producer neutralizes any downstream consumer that compares coordinates.** The scale therefore reads the projectile's `launcher` (untouched source of truth, still standing on the real band) in a prefix on `ProjectileCE.ApplySuppression(Pawn, float mult)` - shape-validated; if CE renames it the combat report shows `suppression seam MISSING`.

**44d. DELIBERATE GAPS** (§13.14): laser (`isInstant`) cross-band shots keep raw `AdjustShotHeight` (tiny angles); lean-offset nuance dropped on cross-band reports; CE turret barrel visuals unaudited; constants pending sliders-on-request.

**44e. VERIFICATION PLAN - REQUIRES `companionMods: ["CETeam.CombatExtended"]`** (CE is installed but inactive; isolated test must load it alongside).
1. `AB2: band info` → `open all bands` → combat logging ON. CE pawns with rifles both sides of an opening.
2. **Down-shot fires:** tracer band-local, impact on the target's level, `CE: solved/originsRemapped` climbing.
3. **Up-shot fires** and draws through the ceiling holes.
4. **Suppression asymmetry (THE spec):** two equal squads exchanging fire through a wide gap - the LOWER side should visibly break first (suppressed icons, hunkering, RunForCover); `suppressionScaled` climbing. Flip: fire up at a ridge line - defenders should shrug it off.
5. **Accuracy:** high shooter vs low shooter hit rates over a burst exchange; `highGroundShots` counts the downward casts.
6. **No spanning flights, no gutter impacts** (CE collision would make these LOUD - explosions in the seam).
7. `AB2: combat report` - check `CE:` line, especially that the suppression seam was FOUND.
**⚠ CE rebalances constantly (cookbook warning): the SEAMS are stable, the NUMBERS drift - if a CE update breaks a seam, the report names it and that seam alone degrades to vanilla behaviour.**
